lessons.title: Irregular Verb to be (bí): Closed questions
lessons.description:
Present Simple closed questions of the Irish verb Bí (to be). An bhfuil mé/tú/sé/sí/sibh/siad
The 11 Irish Irregular verbs: bí (to be), déan (to make), clois/cluin (to hear), feic (to see), abair (to say), ith (to eat), téigh (to go), tar (to come), tabhair (to give), faigh (to receive),
